protocol.entry: signal on completed H1 close; entry next H1 open
protocol.exit: close after fixed 12 H1 bars; non-overlapping per ticker/rule/side
protocol.regime_attribution: Regime measured at signal close. Trend strength is absolute 5-bar percentage slope of SMA50; volatility is ATR14/close. Each is ranked against up to 120 prior valid observations for that ticker, excluding current observation; at least 60 prior observations required. Relative ranks split into low/mid/high terciles.
protocol.periods: first 80% split into three chronological development folds; final 20% holdout shown separately
protocol.reversed: For diagnostic comparison, same signal times and exits with direction flipped; no re-selection or threshold tuning.

limitations: Diagnostic subgroup analysis on the same historical archive; holdout has already been examined in prior experiments and is not a fresh confirmatory sample.
Relative regimes are ticker-specific, not a common market-wide regime.
Tercile subgroup results can be noisy; small sample sizes must not be treated as proof.
Actual spread, commissions, slippage, borrow availability/cost and taxes are not modeled; 5/10 bps per side are illustrative.
Finam H1 candles are technical data; 12 bars are not necessarily 12 clock hours.
Pooled trade-chain statistics are not portfolio returns.
Research only: no production, live signals, Telegram notifications or broker orders.
